title: Fields of the Planet: Field Boundary Mapping Beyond 10m
abstract: arXiv:2607.04449v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Field-boundary accuracy depends on the model, sensor resolution, label discretization, and evaluation procedure. Measuring the contribution of sensor resolution therefore requires a controlled comparison across sensors. We present Fields of the Planet (FTP), a 3 m PlanetScope companion to Fields of The World (FTW) containing 133,168 co-registered patch-window targets across 24 countries. FTP preserves FTW's vector polygons, seasonal windows, and dataset splits, enabling direct comparison with 10 m Sentinel-2. We first quantify the resolution ceiling by rasterizing and vectorizing the same ground-truth parcels at each resolution to determine which fields the label grid can represent. We evaluate predicted parcels with polygon-level and boundary metrics. translated_title: 行星的田野：超越10米分辨率的农田边界制图
translated_abstract: 农田边界制图精度取决于模型、传感器分辨率、标签离散化方式和评估流程。因此，衡量传感器分辨率的贡献需要跨传感器的受控比较。我们提出了 Fields of the Planet (FTP)，这是 Fields of The World (FTW) 的 3 米分辨率 PlanetScope 配套数据集，包含覆盖 24 个国家的 133,168 个配准的图像窗口目标。FTP 保留了 FTW 的矢量多边形、季节窗口和数据集划分，从而能够与 10 米分辨率的 Sentinel-2 进行直接比较。我们首先通过将相同的地真值地块在各分辨率下进行栅格化和矢量化，量化了分辨率上限，以确定标签网格能够表示哪些田块。我们采用多边形级别指标和边界指标来评估预测的地块。在跨传感器使用相同的 PRUE+ 训练和后处理流程、并加入上采样 Sentinel-2 对照组的条件下，我们分离出了图像内容本身带来的性能增益。PlanetScope 提升了全景质量（
tldr: 本文提出了 3 米分辨率 PlanetScope 配套数据集 Fields of the Planet（FTP），与 10 米 Sentinel-2 数据集 FTW 保持完全对齐，通过受控实验分离并量化了传感器分辨率对农田边界制图精度的贡献。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Fields of the Planet (FTP), a 3 m PlanetScope companion dataset fully aligned with the 10 m Sentinel-2 dataset FTW, enabling controlled experiments that isolate and quantify the contribution of sensor resolution to field boundary mapping accuracy.
